note: Machine-readable launch status. G8 (governance) moved UNRESOLVED->PASS via explicit human confirmation (Naoto Fujie, spec/human-decisions.md). G13 (release artifacts) moved CONDITIONAL_PASS->PASS via explicit steward acceptance of the TII 1.0 Production Candidate bundle. G7 (resolver) moved CONDITIONAL_PASS->PASS after independent verification (Vercel CLI + live RDAP) of a domain purchase the operator completed themselves, after Vercel's own CLI refused to execute it non-interactively. G3 (key custody): a key ceremony ran 2026-09-12 (generation + signing/verification/tamper tests, all passing) but G3 remains CONDITIONAL_PASS -- this agent structurally cannot type a passphrase or place an offline recovery copy (no hidden-input channel exists in its tools), so it stopped and handed those two steps to the human operator with exact commands and a checksum, per the ceremony's own explicit STOP rule. No gate was marked PASS merely because more documentation exists, a report was trusted without independent verification, or a security boundary was worked around. See spec/production-launch-gate.md, spec/resolver-domain-decision.md sections 15-18, spec/production-key-custody.md section 8, and spec/human-decisions.md for the full decision trail.
